subject: MAP: Onboarding + Acceptance lanes for evaluation assets (prompt packs & testcases)
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@retaillytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Engineering Team <eng-team@retaillytics.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Eval assets exchange — initial scope and timing

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team at Retaillytics is keen to run a 3-week eval using a small promptpack and a set of ~120 testcases to validate retrieval + generation fidelity for our checkout assistant use case.

High-level asks from our side:
- Short-term: 3-week access window to the promptpack and testcases in a sandbox environment (non-production).
- Usage constraints: ephemeral access (30 days max), no external re-distribution, and ability to run up to 50k tokens/day.
- Acceptance criteria: reproduce the baseline metrics you shared (89% intent precision, <400ms P50).

Can Redwood propose a MAP (mutual action plan) that aligns milestones, acceptance gates, and handback timelines? We also need an unsigned NDA addendum around sample retention.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Product, Retaillytics
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@retaillytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Eval assets exchange — initial scope and timing

Hi Sam — great to hear you're ready to run the pilot. I attached a draft MAP and a sample index of the promptpack/testcase list for review (MAP_Retaillytics_v0.3.pdf, promptpack_sample_index.csv). Key points up front:

1) Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (kickoff, T+3 business days): asset provisioning & sandbox credentials
- Week 1: smoke tests + baseline run
- Week 2: iterative tuning, telemetry collection (we'll provide a short eval harness)
- Week 3: acceptance window + handback (30d ephemeral retention begins on handback)

2) Access & constraints
- Sandbox-only endpoint, limited to Retaillytics CIDR block and test accounts
- Ephemeral dataset retention: Redwood auto-destroys samples 30 days after formal handback unless a retention extension is signed
- No redistribution; samples used only for evaluation; derived prompts/transformations limited to internal dev use

3) Acceptance criteria (pass/fail gates)
- Reproduce baseline metrics within +/- 5% for precision/latency over the acceptance workload
- No P99 latency regressions > 1.5x baseline during the acceptance window

Action items (from Redwood):
- Sofia: finalize MAP PDF and include the acceptance harness link (by Thu EOD)
- Karthik: validate sandbox networking and token limits, advise on required rate limits (by Wed)
- Marissa: confirm whether we can waive the small sample escrow for this pilot (by Fri)

I'll loop legal once you confirm the constraints are acceptable.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Retaillytics_v0.3.pdf (PDF, 125 KB); promptpack_sample_index.csv (CSV, 12 KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam@retaillytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval assets exchange — initial scope and timing

On Wed, Jun 2, 2026 at 3:08 PM Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> 2) Access & constraints
> - Sandbox-only endpoint, limited to Retaillytics CIDR block and test accounts
> - Ephemeral dataset retention: Redwood auto-destroys samples 30 days after formal handback unless a retention extension is signed

Adding a few technical clarifications from infra/ops:
- Token/day cap: we can enforce a soft cap of 50k tokens/day (as requested). If you anticipate bursts, add a lightweight spike policy in the MAP; we can grant a one-time burst for the kickoff run.
- KV cache & prefix caching: we'll enable prefix caching for repeated prompt runs to reduce cost; note that caching can slightly change per-token latency distributions (we'll include it in the baseline harness).
- Data handling: Redwood will ingest samples into an ephemeral vault; access is logged and only accessible to two Redwood engineers and the Retaillytics test accounts specified in the MAP. Audit logs accessible via Console link during the trial.

Open question for Sam: do you want per-route tracing enabled for debug? That will add minor overhead but is often helpful in week 1.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam@retaillytics.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Eval assets exchange — initial scope and timing

Thanks team — quick clarifications from PD/legal ops side:

- Sample escrow: for this short pilot we can avoid a formal escrow, but we need a signed limited-use addendum that enumerates the retention window and prohibits redistribution. I'll have a one-paragraph addendum drafted for signature (Marissa will send by EOD Fri).
- Acceptance harness: the link (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1q2w3MAP_Retaillytics) contains the harness and the testcase_coverage_matrix.xlsx; please do not share outside your evaluation team.
- SLA exceptions: note that pilot runs do not carry SLA credits; if Retaillytics upgrades to Dedicated within 30 days we can convert evaluation metrics into a migration readiness checkpoint.

Ask from Retaillytics: please confirm the list of test accounts and CIDR ranges by Monday so infra can stand up the sandbox on Tue.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product (Evaluation Programs), Redwood Inference

Attachments: testcase_coverage_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 38 KB)
From: Sam Patel <sam@retaillytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval assets exchange — initial scope and timing

All good on our end — Retaillytics accepts the proposed MAP and constraints with two small notes:
1) We'll provide the test account usernames and our staging CIDR by EOD Wed (09 Jun).
2) Please enable per-route tracing for the kickoff smoke run (we'll turn it off thereafter).

We agree to the limited-use addendum; Sam to review and sign once Marissa publishes the one-paragraph addendum.

Next steps (mutual):
- Marissa: share the addendum link and DocuSign tag (by Wed EOD)
- Karthik: provision sandbox with the soft token cap and enable tracing for kickoff (by Thu)
- Sofia: confirm the acceptance harness has the same seed data referenced in the MAP (by Thu)

Thanks everyone — excited to get started.

Best,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Product, Retaillytics
